name: build
author: lumine-code
description: Run project build targets and surface their output and diagnostics.
backgroundTips: You can run the active project target with {{ 'build:trigger' | keystroke }}

saveOnBuild.title: Save Before Running
saveOnBuild.description: Save modified editors before starting a target.

buildOnSave.title: Run After Saving
buildOnSave.description: Run the active target whenever a project editor is saved.

panelVisibility.title: Panel Visibility
panelVisibility.description: Choose when the output panel appears.

panelOrientation.title: Panel Orientation
panelOrientation.description: Choose the workspace edge for build output.

clearOnBuild.title: Clear Output Before Running
clearOnBuild.description: Remove output left by the previous target.

scrollToEnd.title: Follow Output
scrollToEnd.description: Keep the newest output visible while a target runs.

maxOutputLines.title: Maximum Output Lines
maxOutputLines.description: Limit retained output to prevent long-running tasks from consuming unbounded memory.

statusBar.title: Status Bar Indicator
statusBar.description: Show the active target and its current state in the status bar.

statusBarPriority.title: Status Bar Priority
statusBarPriority.description: Set the placement priority of the status-bar indicator.
